# Xray v26.3.27 raw executables r1

This Release contains architecture-specific raw Xray executables for the
installer. Each executable is the unchanged `xray` member extracted from the
corresponding official XTLS/Xray-core `v26.3.27` ZIP after the source archive,
member inventory, raw size, SHA-256, ELF architecture, static linkage, and
reported version are verified.

The files are redistribution artifacts, not custom builds. Verify them with
`xray-v26.3.27-SHA256SUMS`; machine-readable source and extraction details are
in `xray-v26.3.27-PROVENANCE.json`, and the exact upstream MPL-2.0 license is
included as `xray-v26.3.27-LICENSE.txt`.

The older `xray-v26.3.27` Release remains unchanged so installer revisions that
still consume the official ZIP assets continue to work.
